context:
Goal: PR #3606 (the glued-& rebuild) passes its lane lint so it can be handed in.
Problem (rule): lint fails on one job because one of 307 guard mutants survives, and the lane cannot run the likely one, since a hook refuses any command that names install.sh.
Based on (read): the lane's word, relayed by the coordinator at 21:06 CST: the third mutant-test job (a mutant is a deliberate small break in the guard code that a test must catch) caught 306 of 307; the first two mutant-test jobs and every other lint check pass; the log does not name the survivor; the likeliest is the lane's new mutant "handoff-unread: the guard-crash refusal drops its install.sh fix". Triage read #3606 by REST at 21:10 CST: open, draft, and its latest commit matches the lane's.
Based on (read): the PR body says that mutant is unproven in the lane and that the PR's own CI run proves it; the frozen-path hook's text says no override lifts its refusal (the coordinator's relay of it; triage did not read the hook).
Departs from: main — has no such mutant and the frozen-path hook refuses any command naming install.sh; #3606 adds the mutant, and a, b and c change only how its one survivor is named.
Meanwhile: the lane tries c on its own; its other red test rows wait on a separate question to you about which old rule wins.
Waiting on: you.

options.gain: A real name for the survivor, with no bypass; the lane then fixes the killing row.
options.label: You, or a session on your computer, run that mutant (or the third mutant-test job) and name the survivor
options.lose: The lane waits on a person, so #3606 cannot be handed in until then.

options.gain: Quick: the survivor is named in one run.
options.label: You type `override` for one run of that mutant, with a filter that avoids the file name
options.lose: Routes round a refusal whose own text says no override lifts it, and your override may not take (unmeasured).

options.gain: No bypass and no wait on a person.
options.label: The lane finds it by reading only: it lists the tests that cover each mutant's file and checks which mutant has none, then the next lint run proves it
options.lose: Slower, and it may miss the survivor; the lint run then fails again.
